name: Ryo Mou
source:
A bespectacled officer. She was recommended by Shoken for her talent and help with the rebellion against [url=/c25787]En Jutsu[/url]. [url=/c19276]Son Saku[/url] plans to train her to be Son Ken's right-hand man. Her eyesight is pretty lackluster, to the point that she tends to see double of everything. The cause seems to be because she studies at night frequently. 
In one of the late studies, [url=/c204]Kazuto[/url] brings her a snack called Goma Dango. She liked it so much that she became a frequent purchaser and in Moeshouden she went up to the stage and recommend that everyone try it as well.

She is mentioned by name only in Koihime where [url=/c217]Kan U[/url] shows slight irritation for just seeing her on the battlefield (an obvious nod to Lü Meng's Invasion of Jing Providence which led to Guan Yu's historical death).

[Edited from [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_Koihime_Mus%C5%8D_characters#Ryom.C5.8D]Wikipedia[/url]]
